risk.unreadableShell: Runs a shell, so what actually executes is inside the string
risk.deleteEverything: Deletes everything under a root or home path
risk.writeToDevice: Writes raw data to a device
risk.networkCodeAsRoot: Downloads code and hands it straight to a shell
risk.powerState: Shuts down or restarts the host
risk.databaseDrop: Drops a database or a table
risk.recursivePermissions: Changes permissions recursively from the root
risk.permissionsWideOpen: Makes a path writable by anyone
risk.versionControlDestructive: Discards version history or force-pushes over it

container.remove: Removes a container or an image
container.unknown: A container action this version does not recognise

vm.pause: Pauses or resumes a running virtual machine
vm.snapshotTake: Takes a snapshot of a virtual machine
vm.snapshotClone: Creates a copy of a virtual machine from a snapshot
vm.snapshotRevert: Goes back to a snapshot, discarding everything since
vm.guestChange: Changes something inside a virtual machine
vm.guestRemove: Deletes something inside a virtual machine
vm.configRemove: Removes or resizes part of a virtual machine
vm.vprobesLoad: Loads a VProbes script into the hypervisor
vm.clone: Creates a copy of a virtual machine
vm.template: Creates a template or a machine from one
vm.imageChange: Deletes or upgrades a whole virtual machine
vm.guestInput: Types keystrokes into a virtual machine
vm.takeOwnership: Removes a virtual machine's lock and takes ownership of it
vm.unknown: A virtual machine action this version does not recognise

k8s.namespaceDelete: Deletes a namespace and everything in it
k8s.evict: Evicts a pod from its node
k8s.unknown: A cluster request this version does not recognise
